Run the whole pool calculation

compute_pool.Rd

Runs every step from the saved game data to the tables the page uses, in order. The page build and the tests both use this function.

Usage

compute_pool(
  game_results_raw,
  scores,
  projections,
  picks,
  standings,
  yesterday,
  today,
  season_start,
  num_games
)

Arguments

game_results_raw, scores

See compute_game_results().

projections

Win totals, as for add_over_under().

picks

One row per pick, as for score_picks().

standings

Official standings, as for add_projected_to_standings().

yesterday

The last day with results (a Date).

today

The day the page is built (a Date).

season_start

The first day of the season (a Date).

num_games

Games in a season (82).

Value

A named list: game_results, scores_tidy, join_with_projections, standings_grid, scored_picks, changes_in_player_projections, rows_today, projected_score, player_projections_by_team, current_rankings, standings_with_projected, and wins_needed.

Examples

pool <- with(pool_example, compute_pool(game_results_raw, scores, projections,
  picks, standings, params$yesterday, params$today, params$season_start,
  params$num_games))
pool$rows_today
#> # A tibble: 3 × 7
#>   Date       Player Team                 `Current Record` `Current Win %`
#>   <date>     <chr>  <chr>                <chr>                      <dbl>
#> 1 2026-10-21 P1     Alpha                1-1                           50
#> 2 2026-10-21 P2     Alpha                1-1                           50
#> 3 2026-10-21 P2     Los Angeles Clippers 1-0                          100
#> # ℹ 2 more variables: `Vegas Win Projection %` <dbl>,
#> #   `Change in Points Since Yesterday` <dbl>
pool$current_rankings
#> [1] "P1" "P2"
